Cathlyn is an anime writer with years of experience covering some of the biggest and most popular series of all time. She loves writing listicles, features, and query-based articles about all things related to anime. Outside of writing, she enjoys playing mobile games, building Lego and Nanoblock sets, playing pickleball, watching movies, and rewatching her favorite anime series. Before joining GameRant as a contributor, she worked in Epicstream’s anime department. Beyond her passion for anime, she also enjoys writing romance fiction, with her most successful work surpassing one million reads on Wattpad.
Many cyborgs exist in One-Punch Man , most of which rank higher than human heroes and monster villains due to their scientific and technological modifications. Although they grow stronger through multiple upgrades, they still undergo grueling training to adapt their bodies to their new features, skills, and other unique combat attachments.
Among the cyborgs in One-Punch Man , those who continue to upgrade and modify their bodies and abilities have the greatest potential to grow stronger. With their powerful mechanical bodies, they are the ideal fighters against formidable opponents whom ordinary humans would struggle to defeat.
9 Sekingar's Cybernetic Eye Can Fire Lasers at His Enemies
Although Sekingar is among the least powerful cyborgs in One-Punch Man , his greatest strength lies in his leadership abilities, which have earned him the admiration and respect of even heroes like Metal Bat. While he relies on powerful bodyguards like Metal Bat for protection on the battlefield, Sekingar is far from completely defenseless.
Sekingar possesses a cybernetic eye capable of processing and projecting information like a miniature projector. However, it also serves as an offensive weapon, allowing him to fire laser beams at his opponents, although they are considerably weaker than Genos' devastating blasts. It's also not reliable against high-level monsters.
8 Jet Nice Guy's Mechanical Body Gives Him Impressive Punching Power
After winning the lottery, Jet Nice Guy decides to spend his newfound fortune on cybernetic enhancements, transforming himself into a cyborg. Although he only holds a B-Class hero ranking , he is still a capable fighter despite having less advanced cybernetics than many of his fellow cyborgs.
Jet Nice Guy's mechanical enhancements give him enough strength to defeat monsters below the Demon-level threat with a single punch. From his Dash Punch and Sky Spraying Punch to his Energized Dashing Punch, Jet Nice Guy has the means to defeat monsters as a B-class hero.
7 Armored Gorilla Is Built for Close-Quarters Combat
The House of Evolution boasts a formidable battle cyborg in Armored Gorilla, a cybernetic gorilla designed for close-quarters combat. Although he now works as an employee at the House of Takoyaki, he remains a powerful Demon-level threat capable of briefly keeping up with opponents like Genos.
In battle, Armored Gorilla can wreak havoc on his surroundings, smashing concrete structures and leaving massive craters in his wake. He is also exceptionally durable, thanks to his reinforced armor plates, which allow him to withstand devastating physical blows and elemental attacks.
6 Destro's Destroy Mode Makes Him a Brutal Close-Quarters Cyborg
With 94% of his body enhanced by cybernetics, Destro possesses enough power to challenge even an S-Class hero in battle. His true form resembles a heavy-duty combat cyborg, equipped with a terrifying high-output energy cannon capable of unleashing devastating energy blasts.
In combat, Destro primarily relies on his immense physical strength, overwhelming opponents with a relentless series of powerful punches. He can also activate Destroy Mode, which further enhances his offensive abilities and allows him to unleash a barrage of blows that even Metal Bat struggles to defend against. Beyond his impressive attack power, Destro boasts exceptional durability, allowing him to withstand direct strikes from Metal Bat's weapon without going down.
5 Elimin's Eliminate Mode Makes Her a Terrifying Cyborg
With 95% of her body enhanced by cybernetics, Elimin is undoubtedly one of the most powerful cyborgs in the series . Her employers place considerable trust in her abilities, assigning her to guard their headquarters and protect the facility from potential threats. In addition, Elimin becomes a cold and ruthless fighting machine once she enters combat mode.
Elimin has enough strength to contend with formidable opponents like S-class hero Metal Bat and inflict serious injuries. Her Eliminate Mode further enhances her combat capabilities, deploying multiple spider-like mechanical limbs equipped with razor-sharp blades that she can use to stab, slash, and mutilate her enemies.
4 Wavygyaza Is a Powerful Cyborg Hiding Behind an Idol Persona
At first glance, Wavygyaza appears to be a harmless idol singer, but beneath her graceful facade is a powerful cyborg with 71% of her body enhanced by advanced cybernetics. As one of the leaders of the Neo Heroes Organization, she possesses enough firepower to take down Dragon-level threats on her own. Killing a high-level Mysterious Being in one shot is an easy feat for her as well.
In battle, Wavygyaza can unleash devastating energy waves, streams of electricity and fire, and powerful double bomb spheres. She can also fly and hover in midair, giving her greater mobility and versatility against her opponents. Although the series has yet to confirm it, Wavygyaza also appears to have awakened psychic abilities as a result of her brain modifications.
3 The Rampaging Cyborg Has Enough Power to Challenge Blast
The Rampaging Cyborg is the mysterious, deranged cyborg that Genos has spent years searching for in One-Punch Man . It is responsible for destroying Genos' hometown and killing his entire family, making it the ultimate target of his revenge. As such, Genos considers the Rampaging Cyborg his greatest nemesis.
On the battlefield, this mysterious cyborg is an absolute powerhouse, boasting combat capabilities that surpass those of an S-Class hero. Its power also continues to grow without showing any signs of decline, allowing it to destroy entire towns, claim countless lives, and even stand against powerful heroes such as Blast.
2 Bofoi's Most Powerful Weapons Are Capable of Mass Destruction
Bofoi is an invaluable ally to his fellow heroes and a terrifying threat to his enemies, thanks to his massive army of advanced combat robots. The S-Class hero also possesses an arsenal of dangerous weaponry capable of wiping entire countries off the map, with some of his creations potentially powerful enough to destroy the world.
Although Bofoi usually operates behind the scenes, remotely controlling machines such as his Battle and Reconnaissance Robots, he also possesses a high-tech battle suit that even Genos struggles to overpower. Equipped with self-repair capabilities and powerful energy barriers, the suit provides Bofoi with impressive defensive capabilities while allowing him to hold his own against formidable opponents.
1 Genos' Cybernetic Upgrades Make Him One of the Strongest S-Class Heroes
Saitama's disciple, Genos, is a near-indestructible cyborg whose powerful blasts of fire, heat, and plasma easily earn him S-rank hero status. His signature technique, the incineration cannon , can easily ruin any battlefield, not to mention burn his enemies to death.
Although Genos remains inferior to Saitama, he has the strength to take on dragon-level threats by himself. Since his body is almost completely artificial, he doesn't experience fatigue, allowing him to continue fighting even when his body parts are severely damaged. Equipped with powerful attachments, advanced cybernetics, and an energy core that fuels his mechanical body, Genos can unleash devastating attacks and outlast opponents in prolonged battles.
